### The Lord Knows How
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lord-knows-how
Passage: 2 Peter 2:9-10
Points:
- Believers often feel troubled when false teachers and corrupt movements seem to thrive.
- Biblical history proves that God consistently judges wickedness while delivering the righteous, as seen with Noah and Lot.
- The outward success of deception is itself an initial sign of judgment, as God hands the unrepentant over to deeper sin.
- Deniers of Christ remain under sovereign judgment and will inevitably face their final sentence.
- Christians should heed this warning by guarding against persistent sin through fellowship and mutual accountability.

### The Surprising Truth About False Teachers
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-surprising-truth-about-false-teachers
Passage: 2 Peter 2:1-19
Points:
- Christians must expect false teachers to arise and influence society through modern media platforms.
- Deceitful leaders expose themselves not only through doctrinal errors, but especially through their moral conduct.
- The corruption of false teachers consistently manifests in the specific traps of greed, sensuality, and pride.
- Healthy local church communities with close, accountable pastoral relationships provide the best earthly guardrails.
- Believers find ultimate comfort knowing that the Lord knows how to deliver His people from destructive deception.
